tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi sgrub khog chen mo dang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i lag len pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi sgrub khog chen mo dang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i lag len pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mkhyen brtse'i sems dpa' chen po gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo// ngag gi rang bzhin rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa kun 'dus lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs// dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi brtse chen bzlums pa phyag na pad+ma'i mtshan ma can// kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bka' drin zla bral sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes grags pa// bdag yid pad+mor rtag par mchod do yan lag mchog gi zhabs sen 'degs la bdag dga' 'o// 'dir bshad par bya ba ni gnyis/ bdag gzhan thun mong gi don du thugs rje chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i rim pa dang*/ gzhan don du dbang bskur ba'o// dang po sgrub mchod kyi rim pa la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum mo// dang po sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba ni thog mar gang du bya ba'i sa brtag pa gal che ste/ lam srang*/ tshong 'dus/ sde 'khrug byas shul/ dme btsog /dur khrod/ gcan gzan ma rungs pa gnas sa/ mi dang mi ma yin pas bdag tu bzung ba sogs mdor na bkra mi shis shing 'tshe dogs yod sa/ rnam g.yeng dang*/ g.yang sa dang*/ skye bos ya ga sgrog pa'i gnas rnams spangs/ gnas ni dbyibs zlum kha dog rang bzhin gyis dkar ba/ chu bo dang chu mig sogs mang zhing*| 'bras bu can gyi shing skye ba/ bya skad snyan po sgrog pa// ri dwags mdzes pa dang ldan pa sngon rgyal bas zhabs kyis bcags pa sogs mdor na bkra shis shing yid du 'ong ba/ bag dro la nyams dga' ba| dben zhing gtsang ba'i gnas bzung ngo*// der phyin nas skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ khrid gzhung pad dkar phreng bar bshad pa'i thugs rje chen po zhi bar sgrub pa gang yang rung ba zhig byas la bzlas pa brgya stong ci 'grub byas pa'i rjes su/

bar du sa bslang ba ni/ gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ mchod pa dang gtor ma gsum bshams/ tshom bur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi 'dzum phyag g.yas khas len gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs 'chang ba/ dar gyis bklubs pa gsal bar bsam/ rang nyid thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i sa'i lha mo dang*/ gzhi bdag zhing skyong dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ sa'i lha mo bskyed pa'i lha la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ gzhi bdag zhing skyong dang bcas pa 'khod/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma gsum sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ dang po/ oṃ bhūṃ mi pa ti pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ btags pa gsum gyis sa'i lha mo la 'bul/ gnyis pa/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la s+thā na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro gsum gyis zhing skyong dang gzhi bdag la phul nas/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ| tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni// lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum// rab sbyangs btso ma'i mdog mnga' ba// rin chen kun gyi rgyan ldan ma// do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma// mchod dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sems can kun la sman slad du// bdag ni che ge rdo rje yis// 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi// dkyil 'khor chen po bgyid spro bas// de phyir sa 'di bdag la stsol// ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas sa'i lha mos/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod sems can la phan pa'i phyir ci dga' bar byos shig /ces gnang ba byin nas gzhi de nyid du thim par bsam/ zhing skyong dang gzhi bdag rnams kyis de bzhin du gnang ba byin nas so so'i gnas su gshegs/

slar yang rang nyid skad cig gis rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje be con/ g.yon rdo rje'i tho ba bsnams pa/ pad+ma zla nyi dgra bgegs kyi gdan la zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bzhengs pa/ zhal gdang mche gtsigs ljags 'gyur hrīḥdang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'bar ba'i khrod du rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher ba/ dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa dregs pa thams cad kyi rje btsan du gyur par bsam/ lcags kyu'i rgyas/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs dang log 'dren lan chags bu lon gyi bdag po dang bcas pa skad cig gis bkug /oṃ sarba bhū ta bi nā ya ka sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro gsum gyis byin la/ hūm̐ */ nga ni dbang drag 'bar ba ste// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar// bgegs dang log 'dren lan chags rnams// 'dod yon gtor ma 'di khyer la// bdag ni sems can kun don phyir// thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor dag /ji ltar grub par ma gyur bar// gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa rab spongs la// zhi dul byang chub sems bskyed cig /gal te 'gal na brlag par bgyi'o// zhes bsgrags gtor ma phyir dor/ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ zhes bskrad/ thog mar sa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas pa sa la reg la/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi bhi du ra swa bhā wan+tu/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ ha ya grī ba badz+ra rak+ṣa māṃ| sa phyogs de dag dpal chen rta mgrin gyis bsrung bar gyur/ ces brjod/ gzhi de nyid nas sa brkos shing sa ro dang skyon rnams bsal ba'i rnam lnga dang dri bzang gi chus sbrus pa'i stegs bu rgya dpangs mda' gang dang mtho gang pa tsam ci rigs pa/ ngos me long ltar 'jam zhing yo 'chus sogs skyon dang bral bar byas la zla ba ltar dkar zhing mdzes la ngos legs par bya'o// thig skud shing bal sum bsgril la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa nyer gcig dang*| 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer gyi thag par gyur ces byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang de nyid la/ dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal/ zhes btags la bzlas te/ thog mar gnam thig btab pas steng lha'i yul| sa thig btab pas 'og klu'i yul dang*/ zur thig btab pas bar mi'i yul la sogs pa'i 'jig rten thams cad thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gyur bar bsam/ thig rtsa ni gzhung las| phyi nas thig bzhi brgyad bcu drug /de la phyogs bzhir thig brgyad gdab// dang po phyed gse phyi ma gse// gnyis pa bzhi ru gse bar bya// gsum pa'i phyed gdab phyi ma bgo// bzhi pa thig chen rang sar bzhag /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab| |drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gse/ /bdun pa bzhi ru gse bar bya/ /brgyad pa phyed gse phyi ma bgo/ /pho brang dang po pad 'dab bzhi/ /de phyir 'dab ma bcu gnyis la/ /gsum pa'i cha chung 'od zer phreng*// bzhi pa lha yi khyams su bzhag /lnga pa'i nang ma pad ra rtsig /bar ma 'dod yon phyi pha gu// drug pa'i nang ma dra dra phyed// phyi ma da ru pu shu ste/ bdun pa rta babs bang rim bzhi// brgyad pa pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs// 'khor yug dang po pad+ma'i phreng*// gnyis pa rdo ra gsum pa ni// 'od zer lnga ldan me ri bri// zhes pa rnams man ngag lag len ltar dbye/ tshon ni dbus dkar/ ge sar mdzes tshon/ 'dab bzhi shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ mu khyud mdzes tshon/ 'dab ma bcu gnyis sna tshogs mdog /gru chad ljang*/ bar khyams mdzes tshon/ sgo nang bzhi phyogs mdog /rtsig pa dkar mthing dmar ljang*/ 'dod snam dmar/ pha gu ser po la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs/ dra ba dang dra phyed bzhi mthing*/ dra ba dkar/ da ru ka ljang gu la guṇ+ḍa'i rnam pa dkar po pu shu sna tshogs pad+ma/ 'og bzhi phyogs mdog /rta babs ser sngo dmar ljang*/ pad+ma dmar/

'khor lo ser po/ gdugs dkar po la/ yu ba sngon po/ dar dpyangs mdzes tshon/ pad ra sna tshogs mdog /rdor ra gzhi dkar rdo rje sngon po/ me ri kha dog lnga ldan g.yas skor du bris pa'o// de nas dkyil 'khor dbus su stegs kyi khar rin po che'i snod 'bru dkar pos bkang ba'i steng du sku rten 'phags pa'i sku bris sam 'bur ma/ gsung gi rten dngul gyis bris pa'i yig drug /thugs kyi rten sba dkar nag tshig med pa tshigs gsum pa bshams shing*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ pañtsa dzñā na tsakra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes brjod/ rol mo bsgrags shing gu gul gyis bdug go// dkyil 'khor gyi mthar/ spos| mar me/ lha bshos rnams spel ba'i phreng ba zam ma chad pas bskor/ de'i mthar shar du/ mchod yon/ mer dung zhal du zhabs bsil gnyis/ lhor me tog /srin por spos/ nub tu mar me/ rlung du dung chos su dri chab/ byang du zhal zas/ dbang ldan du mtshams 'dzin me tog bshams/ nub phyogs su bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bzhi'i gtor ma dkar zlum brjid cing rgyan dang ldan pa dar gyi rgyal mtshan gyis spras pa rnams bkod legs par bshams/ de'i phyi'i tshon skud lnga'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang logs la mig mang ris bris/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du phur bu re/ zur bzhir mda' dar kha dog lnga ldan me long gis brgyan pa/ logs bzhir ral gri bzhi rnams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ha ya grī ba maṇ+ḍal/ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes bkod/ sgrub po khrus bya/ gos gsar pa gyon zhing bde ba'i stan la dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs par 'dug pa'i mdun du/ ḍā ma ru/ rdor dril sogs nyer mkho rnams ma tshang ba med pa bshams/ de nas skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ rang nyid rta mgrin gyi sku sngar bzhin gsal ba'i phyogs dang*/ gzhi bdag dang*/ bgegs la gtor ma gsum btang*/ mchod pa rnams spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs/

gnyis pa dngos gzhi/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa ni/ bdag gis 'khor ba na gnas pa'i sems can 'di dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ */ rang gi snying khar paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥyig dkar po gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ lo ke shwa ra sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dus gsum bzhugs pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*// thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems sras dang bcas| |sems can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir// rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa dam pa bzhes// tshe rabs sngon nas da lta yan chod du// sdig pa'i las rnams ci bgyis mthol lo bshags// skye bo nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /dus gsum dge rtsa bgyis la rjes yi rang*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhal nas gsungs pa yi// chos 'khor sems can rnams la bskor du gsol| |'gro don mi mdzad mya ngan 'da' bzhed rnams// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags pas// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /ces gsum/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can sdug bsngal ba 'di rnams thams cad snying re rje/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya'o// bde ba dang phrad par bya'o// chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// zhes tshangs gnas bzhi bsam/

mthar/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par mos/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ phyi nang gi chos dngos por gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i rang bzhin du dag pa nga'o// oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de dag thams cad kyang stong pa nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o// zhes yun ring du stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu bsgom/ nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus gsal bzhag spangs pa'i stong nyid 'byams klas pa'i klong chen po/ de'i dbus su raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo nyi shu pa lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar zhing 'khrugs par gyur/ de'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa las/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng rdo rje'i gur khang*/ logs rdo rje'i rtsig pa/ gur khang gi nang du rdo rje'i bla bre dang*/ phyi rol thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang ye shes lnga'i me 'od 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i klong du/ rdo rje mda'i dra ba dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba 'khrigs pas rlung bser bu tsam yang mi thar zhing*/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i bsrung ba'i gur khang sra mkhregs dang ldan pa kho lag yangs shing rnam pa thams cad du gzhom gzhig dang bral ba'i bdag nyid can tu gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi badz+ra pañdza ra badz+ra bi tā na badz+ra re kha badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la badz+ra rak+ṣa ṇa badz+ra a na la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i ra gur gyi nang du bh+rūṃ ser po las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhing khams ma lus par khyab te/ 'od des gzhal med khang thams cad kyi bcud bsdus/ tshur 'dus bh+rūṃ las steng 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs stong dang 'og sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i bar du/

rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bzang gru bzhi sgo bzhir rin po che sna lnga'i rtsig pas bskor ba/ steng du rin po che'i pha gu dang*/ rin po che'i dra ba dang dra phyed/ da ru ka dang pu shu mdzes pas bskor ba'i steng du/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs pa bsgrengs pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung dang dral lcam gyis byur bus phub pa'i rtse mor rin po che 'bar ba'i tog gis mdzes pa/ sgo bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtse mor gdugs dang bcas pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram du lha snam dmar po'i steng du mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha dang lha mo thams cad gar dang glu dbyangs kyi rgyun gyis mchod pa/ khang bzang de nyid 'ja' tshon lta bu'i phyi nang sgrib g.yogs med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ de lta bu'i gzhal med khang pa'i dbus su gru chad ljang gu'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba ge sar mu khyud dang bcas pa dwangs shing gsal la thogs pa med pa pad+ma'i lte ba dang*/ 'dab ma bzhi dang bcu gnyis so so'i steng du'ang sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu pa re re'i lte bar a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ gru chad kyi phyi'i khyams dang phyi'i sgo bzhir pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i gdan re re dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur par dmigs/ lha bskyed pa ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du hrīḥyig dkar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sbyangs nas 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma drug par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po chu shel gyi lhun po nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa ltar dkar zhing 'tsher la 'od zer 'phro ba/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan zhing spyan zhi ba'i nyams can/ shangs kyi dbyibs mtho zhing mdzes pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar mnyam pa'i thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ g.yon 'og mas me tog dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa snyan gyi thad kar bzhad pa'i yu ba 'dzin pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing spyi bor bcings pa zur phud dang ldan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin thang med pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ ska rags/ se mo do/ do shal/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pas mdzes par spras pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dar dpyangs sogs lhab lhub tu g.yo ba/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus kun nas mdzes pa/ de'i mdun gyi 'dab mar hrīḥlas lha mo yi ge drug ma sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso bo dang 'dra ba/ g.yas kyi 'dab mar sras nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che dang g.yon mu tig gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'dab mar sras mo rig sngags 'dzin ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsum ga'ang dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan can yab la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyab kyi 'dab mar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can mnyam pa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing mtshan dpes spras pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can no// phyi'i pad 'dab bcu gnyis la mdun nas g.yas skor gyis pad+ma dang por rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ gnyis par de'i yum sangs rgyas spyan ma gnyis dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ gsum par mi bskyod pa dang*/ bzhi par de'i yum mā ma kī sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/

lnga par rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ drug par de'i yum kun tu bzang mo gnyis ser po g.yas rin po che/ bdun par snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ brgyad par de'i yum gos dkar mo gnyis g.yas pad+ma/ dgu par don yod grub pa dang*/ bcu par de'i yum sgrol ma gnyis ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ bcu gcig par thugs rje chen po dang*/ bcu gnyis par de'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gnyis dkar po g.yas pad+ma bsnams pa/ yab rnams g.yon gdan la brten cing*/ yum rnams g.yon mchog sbyin can g.yas thams cad kyis bka' 'bum gyi sgrub khog tu sangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma kī dang*/ kun tu bzang mo dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rnams ni sku mdog phyag mtshan cha lugs la sogs pa rang rang gi yab dang mthun pa'o| |zhes yab yum phyag mtshan 'dra bar gsungs/ phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin pa de dag thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan cing zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhal yas khang gi khyams la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis po byang chub sems dpa'i cha lugs can gyis bzhugs pa/ shar sgor lha'i thub pa brgya byin dkar po phyag gnyis pi wang 'dzin pa dang*/ lha ma yin gyi thub pa thags bzang ris sngon po ya lad 'dzin pa/ lho sgor mi yi thub pa shākya thub pa ser po gseg shang 'dzin pa/ nub sgor dud 'gro'i thub pa shākya seng ge nag po glegs bam 'dzin pa dang*/ yi dwags kyi thub pa nam mkha' mdzod dmar po rin po che'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ byang sgor dmyal ba'i thub pa chos rgyal nag po me chu 'dzin pa/ drug ka sprul sku'i cha lugs mtshan dpes brgyan cing*/ snam sbyar bla gos mthang gos mnabs nas sgreng ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de ltar dam tshig bskyed pa la ye shes pa gzhug pa ni/ bdag nyid kyang dpa' bo rta mgrin gnas 'gyur ba mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo lta bur skad cig gis gsal ba'i bdag dang mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs kar pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥyig dkar po gnas pa las 'od zer ston ka'i zla zer lta bu rang bzhin gyi gnas su 'phros pas/

bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs skad cig gi mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam/ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hrīḥ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog nas// chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa// thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khor bcas chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas byon par bsam/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// 'gro ba ma lus sems can don mdzad phyir// bdag la thugs rjes nye bar dgongs mdzod la// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhugs la byin gyis rlobs/ */oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrīḥ chos kyi sku la gnyis 'dzin mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don mdzad longs spyod rdzogs skur bstan// thugs rjes cir yang sprul skus 'gro don mdzad// sku gsum ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ zhes mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa la/ bdag dam tshig sems dpas phyag 'tshal bar bsam/ lha ye shes sems dpa' des kyang bdag dam tshig sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal bar bsam/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la// nyon mongs bkres skom gdung ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsag phyir// pū dza'i tshogs kyis mnyes shing bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sarba pū dza me gha hūm̐/ hrīḥ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog bza' btung sgra snyan sogs// phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs bzhes su gsol/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/

gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad pū dza me gha hūm̐/ hrīḥ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs// bkra shis lha mos nam mkha'i khams bkang nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir mchod pa 'bul// dgyes shing bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// badz+ra lā s+ye/ badz+ra shapad/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ badz+ra pañtsa li/ badz+ra dharma sarba pū dza sa ma ya maṇ+ḍal a la la hoḥ zhes phyi rdzas mchod/ nang lha mo'i mchod pa gnyis/ bdag dam tshig sems dpas lha ye shes sems dpa' la sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul nas lha mo rnams tshur 'dus pa las/ bdag dam tshig sems dpa' la bde stong skyes pas rang la mchod par bsam/ de nas gnyis su med par bstim pa ni/ hrīḥ ye shes sku la gnyis 'dzin mi mnga' yang*// gnyis snang ye shes dam tshig sems dpa' la// gnyis su med par brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*// 'gro don phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes lha ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams bdag mdun gyi dam tshig sems dpa' la gnyis su med par bstim/ dngos grub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs par bsam/ de nas dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ hrīḥ sku lnga ye shes lnga yi skur bzhugs nas// rgyal ba rigs lnga 'og min gnas nas bzhengs// rigs kyi bdag pos dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs// rigs lngas ye shes lnga yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ hūm̐ swa āḥhā a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ zhes dbang bskur thob cing bdag mdun gyi lha rnams kyi dbu la dbang rtags rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam| sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med phyir// sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs nas// byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyas gdab bo// kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pas/

bdag mdun gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams las sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po ye shes lha yi lha// yi ge drug ma shes rab dbyings kyi yum| |nor bu 'dzin pa sras mchog thabs kyi tshul// rig sngags 'dzin ma shes rab sras mo'i tshul// ma bsgrub ye nas rang dang dbyer med lha// ye shes lha bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod| |thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// rnam par snang mdzad chos dbyings ye shes ngang*// rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam nyid ye shes ngang*// snang ba mtha' yas sor rtog ye shes ngang*// don yod grub pa bya grub ye shes te// sku lnga ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes rab phar phyin chos sku dbyings kyi ngang*// sangs rgyas spyan ma bsam gtan pha rol phyin| |mā ma kī ni tshul khrims pha rol phyin// kun tu bzang mo brtson 'grus pha rol phyin// na bza' dkar mo sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// dam tshig sgrol ma bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ */ pha rol phyin drug yum gyi sku la bstod// dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas stong dang gnyis// 'gro ba'i don du byang chub thugs bskyed nas// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba 'dul// bskal bzang sems dpa' stong la phyag 'tshal bstod// lha yi thub chen brgya byin lha rnams 'dul// lha min thub pa thags bzang lha min 'dul| |mi yi thub pa chen pos mi rnams 'dul// thub chen shākya seng ges dud 'gro 'dul// thub pa nam mkha' mdzod kyis yi dwags 'dul// thub chen chos kyi rgyal pos dmyal ba 'dul| |'gro drug so so'i skad du chos sgra sgrog /so so'i sdug bsngal sel mdzad skye sgo gcod// thub pa chen po drug la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod do// dngos grub blang ba ni/

hrīḥ thugs rje chen po yab yum sras dang bcas// bde gshegs rigs lnga pha rol phyin drug yum// phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' ting 'dzin sbyong*// sprul sku thub drug 'gro drug thabs kyis 'dul// 'gro ba sgrol phyir thugs rjes sku bskyod la// grub pa rtags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas pas/ ye shes kyi lha rnams kyi sku mi 'gyur ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub/ gsung mi 'gyur ba 'gag med snying po lung gi dngos grub/ thugs mi 'gyur ba spros bral chos nyid rang gsal gyi dngos grub thob par bsam/ bzlas pa dngos ni/ mu tig gam/ shel dkar ram/ dung ngam/ nya phyis sogs khams dkar po las grub pa'i bgrang phreng brgya rtsa brgyad sngon chad gzhan gyis longs ma spyad pa dri bzang gi chus bkrus/ oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags dang*/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ya hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun gyis sbyangs/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma nṛt+ye shwa ra hūm̐/ lan nyer gcig gis byin gyis brlabs/ ye dharma lan bdun gyis rab tu gnas/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas brtan par byas pa'i bgrang phreng mi lag mi brgyud pa lag g.yon du thogs nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥl yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su hrīḥl yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba la phog pas thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul/ bdag mdun thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer phyogs bcu thams cad du 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/

thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams kyi snod bcud thams cad thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs su gyur/ de dag thams cad dang bdag mdun gyi lha gtso 'khor thams cad yi ge drug ma'i sngags 'brug stong ldir ba ltar rgyun mi 'chad du bzla bzhin par gyur par mos la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas pas rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du thugs rje chen po'i sku mthong ba dang*/ gsung gis chos ston pa dang*/ thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'char ba sogs lha grub pa'i rtags ma byung bar du bskyar zhing 'bad do// thun mtshams su dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin brlabs la/ dang po bla ma brgyud pa/ gnyis pa yi dam thugs rje chen po 'khor bcas/ gsum pa yi dam mkha' 'gro spyi/ bzhi pa chos skyong rnams la so so'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan bdun sogs kyis 'bul/ tshogs 'khor bya bar spro na/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshogs rdzas bza' ba g.yas/ ma da na sogs btung ba g.yon/ g.yos su sbyar ba rnams dbus su bshams/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum spros pas tshogs kyi nyes sgrib 'bag btsog thams cad bsregs sbyangs bkrus pas dag par byas/ slar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum spros pas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin can mi zad pa nam mkha' mdzod du gyur par byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang ha hoḥhrīḥgasum spros pas tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin sbyangs shing gcig las du ma nam mkha'i khams gang bar spel la de thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag pa med pa'i 'dod yon rgya mtsho lta bu mtha' dbus tshad gzung med par gyur/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes dang*/ slar yang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ

sarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan bdun gyis kyang byin gyis brlabs shing*/ tshogs phud rnams dkyil 'khor gyi drung du phul la/ hrīḥ rang bzhin dbyings kyi zhing khams nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang po// yab yum sras dang sras mor bcas// mgon po 'od dpag med pa dang*// sems dpa' drug dang sems ma drug /bskal bzang byang sems stong rtsa gnyis// sprul sku thub pa drug dang bcas// ma dang mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang*// chos skyong dam can gter gyi bdag /ma lus gnas 'dir tshogs mgron du// gus pas spyan 'dren mchod bgyid na// thugs rjes ma thogs myur du gshegs// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur// gnas khang 'di la byin rlabs stsol// dkyil 'khor gnyan por brtan par bzhugs// sgrub rdzas tshogs mchod byin rlobs la// zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus gyur| |tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di// yi dam 'phags mchog tshogs la 'bul// bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// phrin las bsgrubs la bar gcod sol// tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di// chos skyong dam can tshogs la 'bul// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// oṃ mū la gu ru pa raṃ pa ra i daṃ de wa ta ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra ḍā ka ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa riwā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ lus ngag yid gsum tha mal du ma shor bar rdo rje gsum gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas tshogs la longs spyod do// lhag ma bsdus par slob dpon gyi kha chus bran te/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/

hrīḥ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lhag ma'i bdag /'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan srung ba'i// rigs lnga'i ging dang laṅka dang*// 'bar ma spor ma pho nya mo// shugs 'gro dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas// 'phags pa'i pha 'bab longs spyod ni// bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs dang bcas// dga' bas khyer la tshim par zo// rangs par mdzod la phrin las sgrubs/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa pa ti sarba bhak+ṣa ku ru māṃ/ zhes gtsang sar 'bul lo// skabs 'dir dngos grub kyi cho ga bya bar spro na dbang chog gi mjug tu yod pa ltar bya/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon dang*// zhabs bsil me tog spos mar me// dri chab zhal zas rol mo bcas// 'dod lnga phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs// 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po yi// 'khor dang bcas la 'bul gyis bzhes// dgyes bzhin dngos grub dam pa stsol// oṃ lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ hrīḥ rang rig thugs rje chen po nyid// rang mdangs yum dang sras pho mo// 'od dpag med du ngang gis shar// tshor drug byang chub sems dpa' drug */ khams drug byang chub sems ma drug /rig rtsal sna tshogs byang sems stong*// skye mched drug kyang thub drug ste// gdod nas rang la rdzogs pa yi// dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ ma 'byor ma rnyed chad cing lhag /'bag btsog gnyis 'dzin dri mas gos// ser sna le lo'i dbang gis nongs// de kun khyed la bzod par gsol| |zhes dang*/ oṃ lo ke shwa ra sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs kyi yi ge brgya pa ci nus kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ/ khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don// legs par mdzad kyi rang gnas su| |gshegs pa gang tshe spyan drang ba// de tshe brtse bas gshegs su gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams phye nas rang gnas su gshegs/

dam tshig gi 'khor lo rnams bdag nyid la thim/ rang nyid thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de yang rim pas je chung du bsdus te/ thig le 'od 'bar bar gyur nas thig le de'ang chos nyid dag pa'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar yal nas mi dmigs par gyur/ chos nyid gdod nas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'o// oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes don dam spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /shis pa brjod pa ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// 'gro drug kun la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// byams dang thugs rje'i thugs kyis skyob mdzad pa'i// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ yi ge drug ma shes rab dbyings kyi yum// nor bu 'dzin pa dbyings las ye shes shar// rig sngags 'dzin ma chos dbyings mnyam pa'i ngang*// thugs rje chen po 'khor bcas bkra shis shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bde gshegs rigs drug sku drug ye shes drug |pha rol phyin drug 'khor ba'i pha rol son// thub drug sprul skus 'gro don sdug bsngal sbyong*// 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi dbyings na gnas// da lta'i sangs rgyas sems can 'gro don mdzad// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'gro kun don la dgongs// dus gsum sangs rgyas stong gi bkra shis shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ye ge drug pa thugs rje sprul pa'i sku// 'gro drug sgrib sbyong 'khor ba'i g.yang sa gcod// byang chub lam 'dren sku gsum sa la 'god// snying po yi ge drug pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro drug yongs la gzigs// thugs rje chen po'i snying rje rgyun mi 'chad// 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon// 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog gi bkra shis shog

/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// longs spyod rgyas shing bsam don 'grub pa dang*| |bar chad med cing sgrub pa mthar phyin nas// brgyud 'dzin byin gyis rlob pa'i bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/ rdul tshon yin na bsdus la bum par stsal te chu klung chen por spyan drangs| ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs bya/ rang nyid rgyun du lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas mi g.yo ba gal che'o/// / ༈ /gnyis pa gzhan don du dbang bskur byed na/ sngon 'gro sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro sta gon ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bdag bskyed sa bslang ba nas bzung*/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa'i bar sgrub khog ltar byas rjes/ lha'i gnas rnams su me tog dkar po'i tshom bu'am/ dri'i thig le gtso bo la gru bzhi/ yum sras sogs bzhi la gtso bo'i phyed re/ thub pa drug la de'i phyed re rnams zlum por bya/ mthar bum pa gnyis dang mchod gtor bshams/ sta gon gyi yo byad rnams slob dpon gyi mdun du bkod la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa nas bzung bzlas brjod kyi bar bdag mdun bskyed pa sgrub khog ltar dang*/ de rjes bum pa gnyis bskyed pa nas las bum gyi lha la phrin las bcol ba'i bar dbang chog ltar grub rjes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang bum pa yol bas bsgribs/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral la 'khod pa zhi bas sbyangs/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ drags pos sbyang ba rnams dang*/ sdig pa sbyong ba til gyi sbyin sreg rnams gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas rjes/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla mas/ rigs kyi bu skal pa dang ldan pa rnams/ sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'jug pa ni/ tshe 'di'i 'bras bu tshe ring ba dang*/ bsod nams che ba dang*/ 'byor ba rgyas pa dang*/

khe grags kyi phyir ni mi bya ste| sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir 'jug par bya dgos la/ gzhan don bsgrub na bdag don zhor la 'byung ste/ dper na/ zhing pas phub sogs kyi phyir so nam byas pa min yang lo 'bras legs na phub sogs zhor la 'byung ba ltar 'dra ba yin pa'o// zhes bshad/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po che// sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs// sangs rgyas sras bcas bdag la dgongs// bdag lus zhing rdul grangs mnyam pa// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// lus ngag yid gsum mchod par 'bul// mi dge'i las byas mthol zhing bshags// dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor rtag tu bskor bar bskul/ mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes bdun rnam dag bya/ bla mas/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni| |khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// dus gsum gyi ni rgyal kun gyis// gsang sngags cho ga 'di mkhyen te// dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du// bdud sde bcom zhing mya ngan 'das// thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan ma brnyes// 'jig rten rjes 'jug la phan phyir// chos 'khor bskor nas mya ngan 'das// khyod kyang kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// blo gros bzang po 'di gyis shig |ces spro ba bskyed/ las bum gyi chus slob ma bsangs/ skad cig gis slob ma spyan ras gzigs gang rung du gsal bar/ dri'i thig le mas nas yar/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes btab pas/ slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po rnam gsal btab/ slar yang mar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes reg pas/

de dag rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du brtan par byas par bsam pas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ de nas nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ 'o ma can gyi so shing sor bcu gnyis pa gas 'khyog rul rdol 'bus zos pa'i skyon med par dri dkar pos byugs shing*/ cod pan dkar po rtse mor btags pa la rta mgrin gyi sngags btab pa slob mar/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes gtad/ slob ma'i mdun du ba byung dang dri dkar pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du tshom bu lnga bkod/ slob mas rkang pa gshibs/ kha lhor phyogs pas thal mo'i bar du so shing sor bcu gnyis rtse mo sos cung zad 'chos te/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hā/ zhes maṇ+ḍal dbus su ltos pa med par dor/ dbus su bab na las thams cad 'grub/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub du dbang*/ byang du drag po/ shar lhor bum pa bzang po/ lho nub tu rkang mgyogs/ nub byang du mig sman/ byang shar du ril bu dang ral gri la sogs pa 'grub/ phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub gang yang mi 'grub par lung bstan/ khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ thog mar chu gtsang gis kha bkrus la/ dung zhal du gnas pa'i dri'i chu/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharma ni tsā s+ya sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni sarba bi kalpa a pā na ya swā hā/ khyor ba g.yas su btab pa lan gsum 'thung du bcug pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag par bsam/ lhag ma cung zad rgyab tu bskyur ro// bsrung ba ni/ ras dkar ram dmar po'i srad bu slob ma rang gi lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bltabs kyis dbus su mdud pa gsum btab pa/ yi ge drug pa dang rta mgrin gyi sngags bzlas shing skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su nyis skor du/ oṃ sarba shud+dhaḥshud+dhaḥmai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes bcing zhing mdud/ mdud mtshams su rdo rje dang las bum gyi chus reg cing rta mgrin gyi sngags kyis rgyas gdab/

ku sha'i chun po che chung rnams bsang sbyangs/ rtswa dang shing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa bsam zhing yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa dhīḥ zhes chung ba sngas dang che ba gdan du byin/ chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u duṃ wā ra'i me tog ltar// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' tsam// gsang sngags spyod pa tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni ches cher dkon// gang gis rnyed pa mnyam med pa// sngags kyi dngos grub bzang po dag /bu khyod la ni 'byung bar 'gyur// rdo rje sngags kyi dkyil 'khor che// nangs par rab tu mthong bar 'gyur// de nas yid rab dang ba dang*// dga' zhing spro ba nyid du gyis// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// gang gis dkyil 'khor chen po dag /skad cig mthong ba tsam gyis kyang*// bskal pa ji snyed bsags pa yi/ */sdig pa thams cad zad 'gyur na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// zhes don bkrol la spro ba bskyed/ kye ma skal ldan sems kyi bu// lha dang bla ma dag la ni// dga' dang mos pa'i sems kyis ni// ku sha'i gdan la khyod nyol la// 'dod don smos la bde bar gnyid// rmi lam bzang ngan gang byung yang*// de kun nga la drang por smros| |zhes gdams la/ slob mas lha dang bla ma la yid dang bas dmod btsug la nyal/ slob dpon gyis mdun bum gyi lha la mchod bstod bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol/ sta gon gyi yo byad rnams bsdus/ bdag dang gnas bsrungs la nyal| nangs par slob ma'i rmi lam dris la/ bzang na spro ba bskyed/ ngan na bzlog pa'i cho ga zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba sogs byas la/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang mchod gtor mda' gri phur bu tshon skud sogs sgrub khog ltar bshams/

dkyil 'khor dbus su sku gsung thugs rten gyi mal du/ rin po che'i bum pa dkar po gas chag med par hrīḥdakar po bris pa'i nang du rta glang gis ma bsgrod pa'i rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang*/ ba dkar mo'i 'o ma la lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas btab pas sum gnyis bkang bar mgul chings dkar po bya/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i dbus su dung chos dri'i chus bkang ba'i steng du rdo rje la me tog dkar po'i phreng ba btags pa bzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi shar du cod pan dmar po/ lhor dbu rgyan/ nub tu ka pā la mtshan ldan bdud rtsi a mṛ tas sbags pa'i myos byed kyis bkang pa'i steng du me long la sin+dhu ras pad+ma 'dab drug bris pa'i lte bar oṃ āḥhrīḥbartsegs pa/ 'dab drug la yi ge drug pa 'bru re re bris pa'i steng du bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ cu gang*/ gur gum/ phyi nang gi bdud rtsi lnga rnams mngar gsum dang sbyar ba'i ril bu dar dkar gyis dril la bzhag /byang du rdor dril/ shar lhor sku'i rten bris sam 'bur ma| lho nub tu gsung rten dngul gyis bris pa'i yi ge drug pa dang shel phreng*/ nub byang du thugs kyi rten chos dbyug dkar po tshigs gsum pa/ byang shar du me long*/ gzhan yang pad+ma dang rin po che'i gdan khri/ gdugs/ sgrub skor gyi po ti/ ril ba spyi blugs/ dung*/ mig dar/ me tog /mig thur/ ḍā dril sogs dgos pa'i yo byad cha tshang ba dang*/ las bum kha dog dmar po kha rgyan gyi dbus su seng ldeng gi phur bu dang mgul chings dmar po dang bcas pa hrīḥdamar po bris pa/ lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang rgyun 'bab kyi chus bkang ba rnams bkod legs par bshams/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgribs/ gzhan yang dngos grub kyi rdzas dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ shing thog la sogs pa kha na ma tho ba med pa sna tshogs gtsang zhing yid 'ong bar byas la bkod do// bdag mdun bskyed pa nas bzlas brjod kyi bar sgrub khog chen mo'i skabs bshad pa ji lta bar byas la/

bum pa gnyis bskyed cing dbang rdzas byin brlab ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa gnyis kha g.yel/ zhabs zhum/ lto ba ldir ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa'i nang lha'i chu bos gang ba gnyis kyi rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa lte ba ge sar mu khyud dang bcas pa dwangs shing gsal la thogs pa med pa zhes pa nas/ sgreng ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar dkyil 'khor cho ga'i mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar la/ sangs rgyas stong bskyed skabs/ gzhal yas khang gi zhes pa dor nas/ khyams la zhes dang*/ thub pa drug bskyed skabs/ shar sgo sogs dor nas/ shar du zhes sogs bsgyur ro// las bum gyi nang du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi gdan la dpa' bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i be con dang*/ g.yon rdo rje'i tho ba bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis dor stabs/ zhal rngam zhing mche ba gtsigs pa spyan gsum 'khrugs pa hrīḥdang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa dbu gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher bas gnod byed tshar gcod pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du 'gyings pa/ de ltar bum pa gnyis kyi lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bum pa'i lha bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

dam tshig pa rnams la ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs 'gugs pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ 'ching ba dang*/ dbang du bya zhing dgyes par byas pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis// skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur ba// ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis 'dir// dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs lngas dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ mchod pa ni/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas par// gtsang zhing dag pa'i mchod yon gang mchis pa// bdag blos bzung ste bum pa'i lha la dbul// bzhes shing dgyes te dbang bskur dngos grub stsol// oṃ ār+ya a ba lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon gyi gnas su| zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shapad sbyar bas mchod| gang zhig gzugs su snang ba ni// rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar// sprul te bum pa'i lha la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra rū pa badz+ra pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes gzugs kyi gnas su/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya/ dang*/ rū pa'i gnas su/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she sbyar bas mchod/

slar yang*/ hrīḥ gtsang zhing gtsang mar rab sbyar bas// ro brgya ldan pa'i gtor ma dang*// bza' bca' btung ba la sogs pa// 'dod dgur bcas pa'i mchod pa rnams// bla ma dang ni 'phags pa'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes shig rol cig tshim par mdzod// dgyes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra gu ru ā di de wa ta ḍā ka ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ba liṃ bhak+ṣa pi ba tha sarba kā ma pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes gtor ma sogs 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag las| |sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i zlos gar ni// 'phags pa phyag na pad+ma 'dzin// phyag 'tshal 'jig rten dbang phyug la// thabs shes snang stong ngo bo las// yum sras pho mo 'od dpag med// chu zla bzhin du der snang ba// phyag 'tshal ye shes lha bzhi la// phung khams skye mched rnam dag pa// rigs drug yab yum sems dpa'i tshul// gang la gang 'dul tshul ston pa// phyag 'tshal sems dpa' bcu gnyis la// thog med dus nas sangs rgyas kyang*// 'gro la sman slad byang sems tshul// bskal bzang 'di la rab gshegs pa// phyag 'tshal byang sems stong rtsa la| |nyon mongs drug gis dbang byas pa'i// rigs drug ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir// sprul pa snang brnyan thub pa'i dbang*// phyag 'tshal ston pa rnam drug la// pad+ma rigs kyi khro bo che| |bdud bgegs tshar gcod dpa' bo ni// dbang skad stong gsum 'dar zhing g.yo// phyag 'tshal ha ya grī ba la// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ gzung thag la 'khril te song*/ bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa yongs su gang ba gyur par dmigs/ hūm̐ zhes gzung thag gi sne mo la lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas gzung nas yi ge drug pa brgya stong ci mang bzla/

slar gzung thag las bum gyi khar bzhag ste/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ gzung thag la zhon te song ba las thams cad pa'i lha'i thugs kar thim pas thugs brgyud bskul/ sku'i cha las bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang zhing bar chad bsrung bar gyur par bsam la/ oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐/ oṃ ha ya grī ba hūm̐/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ slar bum pa'i lha la mchod cing bstod nas/ bum pa'i lha la mchod cing bstod pas mnyes nas rang bzhin du zhu bas ngo bo lha la rnam pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ las thams cad par sngags bzlas pa'i yungs kar blugs la/ las bum gyi lhas 'dir dbang bskur ba sogs 'dod pa'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs dang rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad bsrung zhing bzlog par mdzod cig /ces phrin las bcol/ dbang rdzas gzhan rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ cod pan la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas rnams la thim par gyur par dmigs nas yi ge drug pa ci nus bzla/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi ni ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i bde ba bskyed nus pa'i sman bcud len 'chi med kyi rang bzhin du gyur par mos la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ las thams cad pas khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas thugs rje chen po zhig sprul nas slob dpon gyis bya ba mdzad par bsam/ maṇ+ḍal nas bzung gzhan don rjes gnang gi bar slob ma la bskur ba ji bzhin pa rgyas par byed na sngags tshig gnyis ka dang*/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis bdag 'jug blangs/

gtang rag maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan med phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa ste| |de bzhin nyid bdag dag pa'i bdag /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rigs rnams kun gyi bdag por mdzod// chos kun nam mkha' lta bu ste// mtshan nyid thams cad rab spangs pa// mtshan min mtha' las rnam par grol// dmigs su med pa'i ye shes mchog /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di// slob ma rnams kyis mthong bar shog /ces gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor gtso bos de ltar gyis shig ces gnang ba bstsal bar bsam/ slob ma gzhug pa ni/ tshul mi mthun pa med cing nang gshin pa'i slob ma zung du ma gyur pa las bum gyi chus bkrus/ gral la 'khod/ bgegs la gtor ma byin la bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgoms/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag gis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags bya/ sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bzhi bshad pas rgyud sbyangs/ thugs rje chen po'i lam 'di byin rlabs che zhing 'phags tshul dang*/ rgyal po bka' 'bum gter du bzhugs pa sogs brgyud rim bshad la spro ba bskyed/ chas su gzhug pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a laṅkār was+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes stod g.yogs dkar po/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a laṅkār pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ gis smad g.yogs dmar po/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hoḥ zhes gtsug tor sbyin/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra ma nā ya swā hā/ dar ras dmar pos mig dgab/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis cod pan gtad/ slob ma'i mgor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas bzung ste khyod rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ khyod kyis thugs rje chen po'i gsang ba 'di ma thos shing ma mthong ba su gang la'ang smra bar mi bya ste gal te smras na khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur bas so| |zhes gsang bar gdams/

slar rdo rje mgo dang snying khar gtad/ oṃ/ de ring 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// khyod ni rgyal ba'i sras su skyes// lha rnams dang ni skal mnyam gyur// gal te dam las 'gal 'das na// khyod kyis bde ba rab spangs nas// rdo rje'i dmyal bar sreg par byed// de bas dam las ma 'da' srungs// zhes phan yon dang nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag mna'i btung ba sbyin pa la/ hrīḥ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ste// mchog dang thun mong kun 'grub byed// gal te dam las khyod 'das na// rdo rje khro bo mi bzad pa// ha ya grī ba dbang gi lhas// khyod kyi snying khrag bzhes te 'thung*// de bas dam las ma 'da' srungs/ oṃ ha ya grī ba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥhūm̐/ zhes byin/ slob mas/ sa ma ya i dan+te na rak+kan/ zhes bro bor/ slar rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ hoḥ deng nas bzung ste khyod kyis 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug nga yin gyi/ ngas ji ltar gang bsgo ba de ltar khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ gal te 'gal na khyod ya nga ba ma spang bar tshe'i dus byas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar gdon mi za'o| |zhes slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag /de nas slob mas thal sbyar me tog dang bcas pas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bla mas/ rigs kyi bu khyod thugs rje chen po yi dam du 'dzin par 'dod pa de legs so// de bas na de'i phyir dus de ring nas bzung ste skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sdom pa bzung ba dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par gyis shig /ces gnang ba sbyin/ slob mas slob dpon la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyi mos pa dang bcas thal mo sbyar/

khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum nod cing khas blang ba ni/ 'di skad brjod du gzhug /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang*// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum// gus pas yang dag gzung bar bgyi// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// smon pa'i sems dang 'jug pa'i sems// don dam sems mchog bskyed par bgyi// bde gshegs sku yi rigs mchog dang*// rdo rje'i rigs dang rin chen rigs// pad+ma'i rigs dang las kyi rigs// rigs 'dus thugs rje chen po yi// dam tshig rjes su gzung bar bgyi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// dbang bskur mchog de bdag la stsol// ces gsum brjod/ de ltar skyabs 'gro gsum ldan/ sdom pa gsum ldan/ dam tshig gsum ldan gyi don rnams go don 'phrod nges su bla mas bshad/ sngags su sems bskyed pa ni/ slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phros pas gnyis snang gi rtog pa sbyong ba zhig gsal btab/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes brjod/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir bla mas me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje slob ma'i snying khar reg ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob ma rnams ma yeng rtse gcig pas 'di ltar mos/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thugs rje chen po phyag gnyis pa'am/

bzhi pa'am/ bcu gcig zhal lam| phyag stong gang mos su bskyed/ slob dpon thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros pa slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer dang 'dres/ phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs slob ma rnams la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ mthar de dag thams cad rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa ltar slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim pas dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ bla mas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī bud+dha bo dhi satwa dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra e ā ra li pheṃ pheṃ dza dza dzaḥhriṃ hriṃ hriṃ ā we sha ya a a aḥ zhes bzlas/ sbyar ba'i spos sreg /ḍā dril drag tu 'khrol/ rol mo bsgrags/ spro na skabs 'dir ma ṇi ril sgrub tu bshad pa'i byin 'bebs la dbyangs rol 'cham dang bcas brjid chags par byed/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rje rgya gram slob ma'i mgor bzhag nas brtan par bya/ slob mas cod pan thogs te/ hoḥ rang rig snang ba'i cod pan 'di// rig mdangs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rig rtsal dad pas 'bul lags na// 'brel ba gang yod rigs dang sprod// puṣ+pe pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes dor/ gang la bab pa'i dbus su mchog /phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi/ phyi rol du dngos grub phra mor lung bstan/ me tog de nyid slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ kye/ sems dpa' stobs po che khyod kyi// rigs dang mthun pa'i slob ma 'di// brtse bas rjes su bzung nas kyang*// mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/

zhes brjod/ mig dbye ba'i phyir slob mas/ e ma bla ma rdo rje 'dzin// 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas// bdag sogs 'gro rnams ma rig pa'i// ling tog ye shes ngang du sol// zhes gsol ba btab/ bla mas gser gyi mig thur gyi rtse mos dngul snod du gnas pa'i mig sman dang dkyil 'khor gyi rdul phran phra mo blangs la/ hoḥ skal ldan rigs mchog bu rnams kyi// nyon mongs ma rig 'khrul ba'i yid// ling tog lta bu'i rab rib tshul// bdag gi ye shes thur ma 'dis// rig pa rang gsal ngang du phye// rang byung lha tshogs mthong bar bgyi// oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣuḥpra we sha yā mi/ zhes dbye ba'i rgyas mig dar bsal/ kye/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu mchog rnams// mtshon byed sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ltos// mtshon bya don gyi 'od zer mthong*// rang rig mtha' bral spyan ras gzigs// rig mdangs yum sras 'khor gyi tshogs// rig rtsal 'khor bcas yongs su rdzogs| |don gyi 'od zer mthong ba na// 'khor 'das yid spyod mtshan ma'i chos// kun rdzob dkyil 'khor lta ci smos// zhes blta bar bskul/ kye/ rigs kyi bu rnams kun rdzob mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la ni/ bsrung ba'i gur khang me ri rdo rje ra ba la sogs pa'i dbus su thar pa chen po'i pho brang rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang bzang gi dbus su/ gdan pad+ma zla ba'i dbus su thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ de'i 'khor gyi tshul du mdun du yum yi ge drug ma/ g.yas su sras nor bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du sras mo rigs sngags 'dzin ma/ rgyab tu rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ de'i phyi skor du rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rgyal ba drug dang*/ g.yon du sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa rang rang gi yum drug ste bcu gnyis/ khyams la bskal bzang 'dir 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis po byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyi cha lugs can/

sgo bzhir rigs drug gi sgrib pa sbyong mdzad sprul pa'i thub pa drug rnams bzhugs pa ni/ rnam pa brda tsam btags tsam mtshon dpe tsam yin gyi/ don du rang rig rang gsal thugs rje chen po/ de'i snang ba'i cha yum/ stong pa'i cha rigs bdag /thabs kyi rang bzhin sras/ shes rab kyi rang bzhin sras mo/ nang gi skye mched drug dang khams drug dag pa rgyal ba rigs drug /phyi'i skye mched drug dang 'byung ba dag pa yum drug rig rtsal nyon mongs pa thams cad dag pa byang chub sems dpa' stong rtsa gnyis/ gnas ngan len rigs drug dag pa sprul pa'i thub pa drug ste/ don rang sems las gzhan pa'i thugs rje chen po zhes mngon sum rdzas grub tu yod pa ma yin pas/ de lta bas na/ kun rdzob dpe'i mtshon byed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di mthong bas/ don dam mtshon bya rang rig thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gdod nas grub pa de nyid ngo shes shing rtogs par byos shig /ces brda sprad do// slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ kye ma/ phyag byar 'os pa khyod rnams la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud nas ni rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag bgyi'o// oṃ mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru ā di de wa ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ zhes phyag bya/ dbang dngos gzhi bskur ba ni/ slob mas/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab la/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ hrīḥ bkra shis bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang*// thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gnas// gnyis su med pa byang chub sems kyi chus// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// lus ngag yid gsum bag chags sgrib sbyangs nas// lha yi sku gsung thugs su 'grub bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes slob ma'i gnas rnams su bskur/

bum chu khar sbyin/ de ltar bum pa'i nang nas rnam pa chu/ ngo bo lhas dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas lha'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam| de nas sku rten mgo bor bzhag ste/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po ye shes lha yi lha// 'gro drug kun la thugs rjes mnyam par gzigs// rang rig byang chub sems kyi lha yin pas// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// lus kyi sgrib pa bag chags kun byang nas// thugs rje chen po'i sku ru 'gyur par shog /ces dang*/ slar yang*/ bde gshegs rigs bsdus lha yi dbang*| |de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// rigs bsdus thugs rje chen po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dang*/ slar gtso bo'i sku rten gyi dbang bskur zhing*/ hrīḥ thabs mchog bde ba chen po rig pa'i sku// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang sems dpa' che// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi brtse ba'i bdag |'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal bas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ de bzhin du yum gyi skus/ hrīḥ shes rab stong nyid dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma// rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'phags pa'i dgyes pa skong*// mkha' dbyings klong yangs sangs rgyas kun mnyes bdag /yum mchog yi ge drug mas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sras kyi skus/ hrīḥ nga ru 'dzin dang rtag par lta ba'i bdud// ma lus 'joms mdzad rang rig ye shes lha// thugs rje chen po'i dbyings las rab sprul pa'i// sras mchog nor bu 'dzin pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sras mo'i skus/ hrīḥ nga yir 'dzin pa chad par lta ba'i bdud// ma lus 'joms mdzad stong nyid rdo rje ma// yi ge drug ma'i mkha' las rab sprul pa// sras mo rigs sngags 'dzin mas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

'od dpag med kyi skus/ hrīḥ rigs kyi bdag po a mi de wa ni// ma bcos rang byung lhun grub ye shes ngang*// rgyal ba kun gyi dbang bskur bka' rtags kyi// cod pan 'od dpag med kyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ rnam snang yab yum gyi skus/ hrīḥ chos dbyings ye shes de bzhin rigs kyi gtso// rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba'i sku yi lha// yum mchog spyan ma bsam gtan pha rol phyin// yab yum mnyam par gnas pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ mi bskyod yab yum gyi skus/ hrīḥ me long ye shes rdo rje rigs kyi gtso// mi bskyod rgyal ba thugs kyi rigs kyi lha// yum mchog tshul khrims phar phyin mā ma kī// yab yum mnyam par gnas pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ rin 'byung yab yum gyi skus/ hrīḥ mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen rigs kyi gtso// rin chen 'byung ldan rgyal ba yon tan lha// yum mchog kun bzang brtson 'grus pha rol phyin// yab yum mnyam par gnas pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ snang mtha' yab yum gyi skus/ hrīḥ sor rtog ye shes pad+ma rigs kyi gtso// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal ba gsung gi lha// yum mchog gos dkar sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// yab yum mnyam par gnas pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ don grub yab yum gyi skus/ hrīḥ bya grub ye shes las kyi rigs kyi gtso// don yod grub pa rgyal ba'i phrin las lha// yum mchog sgrol ma bzod pa'i pha rol phyin// yab yum mnyam par gnas pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi skus/ hrīḥ rang byung ye shes rigs kun 'dus pa'i gtso// spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin mar bcas// yab yum mnyam par gnas pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

byang chub sems dpa'i sku zhig gis/ hrīḥ dus gsum kun tu mngon par sangs rgyas kyang*// 'gro ba'i don slad byang chub thugs bskyed nas// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad// bskal bzang sems dpa' stong gi dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ lha'i thub pa'i skus/ hrīḥ nga rgyal nyon mongs dbang gis 'khrul 'khor ba// lha rnams 'dul mdzad thub pa brgya byin tshul// 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal lnga sogs rab sbyong ba// lha yi skye sgo gcod pa'i dbang bskur ro| |oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// lha min thub pa'i skus// hrīḥ phrag dog nyon mongs dbang gis 'khrul 'khor ba// lha min 'dul mdzad thub pa thags bzang ris// 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal ma lus rab sbyong ba// lha min skye sgo gcod pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ mi'i thub pa'i skus/ hrīḥ 'dod chags nyon mongs dbang gis 'khrul 'khor ba// mi rnams 'dul mdzad thub pa shākya'i rgyal// gsog srung 'tshol dkrol re dogs sdug bsngal sbyong*// mi yi skye sgo gcod pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// dud 'gro'i thub pa'i skus/ hrīḥ gti mug nyon mongs dbang gis 'khrul 'khor ba// dud 'gro 'dul mdzad thub pa shākya seng*// glen lkugs sdug bsngal ma lus rab sbyong ba// dud 'gro'i skye sgo gcod pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ yi dwags thub pas/ hrīḥ ser sna nyon mongs dbang gis 'khrul 'khor ba// yi dwags 'dul mdzad thub pa nam mkha' mdzod// bkres skom sdug bsngal ma lus rab sbyong ba// yi dwags skye sgo gcod pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// dmyal ba'i thub pas/ hrīḥ zhe sdang nyon mongs dbang gis 'khrul 'khor ba// dmyal ba 'dul mdzad thub pa chos kyi rgyal// tsha grang sdug bsngal ma lus rab sbyong ba// dmyal ba'i skye sgo gcod pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

zhes sku so sor dbang bskur/ slar yang*/ gtso bo'i sku rten gyi dbang bskur zhes pa nas dmyal ba'i skye sgo gcod byed ces pa'i bar gtso 'khor gyi lha dbang 'di rnams rung mthun du sbyar ba yin pas spro na byas kyang lhag pa'i skyon mi 'byung ba dang*/ mi spro na bka' 'bum gzhung gi dbang chog tu 'khor gyi lha dbang ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon ni 'byung ba ma yin par shes par byos shig /de ltar lha'i dbang bskur bas/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum dag nas lha'i sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ gzugs su mthong ba thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur shes par gyis shig /ces don bshad/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ hrīḥ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje yi// sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang mchog 'di// de ring khyod la bskur ba yis// thugs rje mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces shis par brjod/ slar rig dbang lnga bskur ba ni/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ hrīḥ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni| |lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ// zhes bum chu sbyin/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang gis kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas su dag /me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa lam du byas pas/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa dpral ba'i steng du bzhugs par bsam la/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// gti mug rnam par dag pa yi// me long ye shes dbang thob nas// thogs pa med pa'i bkra shis shog /ces me tog 'thor/ dbu rgyan bskon la/ hrīḥ 'khor 'das kun gyi rgyal srid la// dbang sgyur rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dbang*// de ring khyod la bdag gis sbyin// khams gsum kun gyi rgyal por gyur// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas su dag /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan lam du byas pas/ rin chen 'byung ldan rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhugs par bsam/ hūm̐ */ rin chen rigs kyi dbang bskur bas| |nga rgyal rnam par dag pa yi// mnyam nyid ye shes dbang thob nas// yon tan mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces shis par brjod/ rdo rje ltag pa dang lag pa g.yas su sbyin zhing*/ hrīḥ thabs mchog rdo rje mi shigs pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bdag gis sbyin// thabs kyi dam pa 'grub gyur cig /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbang bskur bas yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas su dag /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas lam du byas pas/ snang ba mtha' yas ltag pa'i steng du bzhugs par bsam/ hūm̐ */ pad+ma rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa yi// sor rtog ye shes dbang thob nas// shes rab mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces shis par brjod/ dril bu rna ltag g.yon dang*/ lag g.yon du sbyin la/ hrīḥ rgyal ba'i chos rnams ma lus pa// shes rab dril bu'i sgra yis ston// de ring khyod la bdag gis sbyin| |sher phyin don kun rtogs par shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dharma badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa'i dbang bskur bas/ sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas su dag |bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sangs rgyas don yod grub pa lam du byas pas/ don yod grub pa rna ltag g.yon pa'i steng du bzhugs par bsam/ hūm̐ */ las kyi rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// phrag dog rnam par dag pa yi// bya grub ye shes dbang thob nas// phrin las grub pa'i bkra shis shog

/ces shis pa brjod/ cod pan dmar po mgor bzhag nas/ hrīḥ rtag pa'i rgyal po sems dpa' mchog */mi rtag bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal/ */de ring khyod la bdag gis sbyin// mi shigs rdo rje'i sa thob shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bud+dha nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ kyai dpal zhes bos nas/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug /brtse ba'i bdag po// pad+ma sems dpa' sogs gsang ming btags/ bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang bskur bas ming gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas su dag */ chos dbyings ye shes rgyud la skyes// sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad lam du byas pas spyi bo'i gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad rtag pa'i rdo rje bzhugs par bsam/ hūm̐ */ bde gshegs rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// zhe sdang rnam par dag pa yi// chos dbyings ye shes dbang thob nas// ting 'dzin mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ de ltar rig pa'i dbang bskur bas ma rig pa lnga dag /ye shes lnga rgyud la skyes/ rigs lnga lam du byas pas rigs lnga'i dbang zhes bya'o// des rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lus yongs su smin par byas/ lha'i sku bsgom pa dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob rung gi rten 'brel gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes go ba sbyin/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ thugs rje chen po khyod zhabs kyis// deng bdag yongs su smin bya'i phyir// gsang ba byang chub sems mchog gi// dbang bskur ye shes bskyed du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ zhes brgya rtsas thod pa'i me long steng gi bdud rtsi ril bu byin gyis brlabs/ ril bu bla ma'i mtha' ltag gis bu'i gnas gsum du reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ zhes brjod pas/ bla ma'i dpral mgrin snying lte ba bzhi nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser 'phros/

slob ma'i dpral mgrin snying lte bzhir thim pas slob ma'i spyi bor rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i dbus su oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i dbus su āḥdamar po/ snying khar rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i dbus su hrīḥser po rnams gsal btab/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i yon tan phrin las thams cad dang ldan par bsam/ hūm̐ */ byang sems dkar dmar thabs dang shes rab ste// bcud mchog bdud rtsi'i ro mchog bde ba bskyed// yab yum gnyis med snyoms 'jug byang chub sems// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas| |ngag la bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myangs gyur nas/ */lus ngag yid gsum bde ba skyed par shog */oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bdud rtsi ril bu khar bcug /de'i ro myong ba de dag bde gsal mi rtog dbyer med byed pa'i nyams bzhi ngos 'phrod par sprad/ des bla ma yab yum gyi mkha' gsang gi dkyil 'khor chen por gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag */ ngag yongs su smin par byas/ rlung rdo rje sngags kyi bzlas pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob rung gi rten 'brel gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bcom ldan zhi ba dga' chen po// rdo rje pad+ma sbyor las byung*// bde chen de ni 'khor ba las// sgrol byed dbang bskur bdag la stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi bla ma'i lag tu thogs la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas lha rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bde ba'i ngo bo bdud rtsi dkar dmar bab pa ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang mnyam gcig 'dres par bsam/

slar slob mas dngos sam yid rig la snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba lha tshogs la mchod pa phul bas bde stong gi nyams nam mkha'i khongs su yang mi shong pa slob ma'i rgyud la skyes par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ */ thabs shes dbyer med bde ba'i bcud// phyag rgya bzhi ldan chos kyi dbang*/ */dga' bzhi ye shes khyad par can// zag med bde chen stsol ba mdzod// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bo dhi tsit+ta dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bdud rtsi khar sbyin| lan gsum 'thung du gzhug /me long gi sin+dhu ras dpral bar thig le byas/ des gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor chen por shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /yid yongs su smin par byas/ thugs rdo rje pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob rung gi rten 'brel gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes brda sprad la/ tshig dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ kye hoḥ rdo rje 'dzin zhabs bka' drin gyis// spros pa'i dbang bskur bstsal lags kyi// spros med don gyi dbang bskur che// thugs rje chen pos bdag la stsol| |ces gsol ba btab/ sin+dhu ra med pa'i me long bstan la/ kye/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung*// rdo rje sems dpa'i me long bzhin// de ni gsal dwangs rnyog pa med// sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rang bzhin med cing gnas med pa// chos kun de ltar shes nas su// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// zhes dang*/ de'i don bkrol la ngo sprad/ des spros dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po tshig gi dbang bskur ba thob/ lus ngag yid gsum cha mnyam der 'dzin gyi sgrib pa dag /sgo gsum yongs su smin par byas/ ye shes rdo rje bsam du med pa'i rang bzhin bsgom pa la dbang*/

'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob rung gi rten 'brel sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes go ba bskyed/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ dngul gyis bris pa'i yi ge drug ma slob ma la bstan la| hrīḥ yi ge 'bru drug sprul sku cho 'phrul drug /'gro drug skye sgo gcod cing sgrib pa sbyong*// thugs rje chen po'i yang snying yi ge drug /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// ngag gi sgrib pa bag chags kun sbyangs nas// thugs rje chen po'i gsung dang dbyer med shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun rjes zlos bya bar gzhug /shel phreng gtad la/ hrīḥ yi ge drug ma rdo rje'i sgra// rlung sngags dbyer med rgyun mi 'chad// rdo rje'i bzlas pa la brtson na// sgrub pa 'grub kyi gzhan du min// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes gtad do// des ni gsung snying po sngags kyi bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ste/ sgra ru grags pa thams cad sngags kyi rang sgrar shes par gyis shig /de nas rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ chos dbyug lag tu gtad la/ hrīḥ rang byung chos sku skye ba med pa la// sna tshogs 'char ba rig pa'i rtsal yin te// dbang po tshogs drug yul drug nas gsal ba// nyon mongs drug ni sku drug ye shes drug /rang shar rang grol chos nyid rol pa'i ngang*/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chog thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gtad la/ chos kyi dbyug pa kha dog dkar ba ni/ chos nyid byang chub kyi sems gdod nas dri ma med pa'i rtags/ gcig pur skyes pa ni/ ma bcos rang byung gi ye shes 'di nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba gcig po yin pa'i rtags/ tshigs gsum 'dug pa ni/ sku gsum logs su med de rang la shar ba'i rtags yin pas des mtshon nas go bar byos la/

dus da nas bzung nyon mongs pa lnga spang du med/ ye shes drug dang sku drug rang byung rang shar rang grol du grol ba yin no// de ltar na dbang thams cad kyi mes po rtsa bar gyur pa ni/ rig pa rtsal gyi dbang 'di yin la/ 'di nyid thob na dbang thams cad thob pa yin/ 'di nyams su myang na dbang thams cad nyams su myong ba yin/ 'di'i don rgyud la skyes na dbang thams cad kyi don rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ */ de lta bu gang las skye zhe na/ sangs rgyas dang sems can zhes pa ni rig ma rig rtogs ma rtogs las byung ba yin te/ ma rig ma rtogs tshe 'khor ba dang ngan song yin/ rig cing rtogs pa'i tshe mya ngan las 'das pa dang sangs rgyas yin no// de'ang rang rig pa don dam byang chub kyi sems de ni/ nangs rtogs na nangs sangs rgyas/ nub rtogs na nub sangs rgyas/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems de'ang don dam du 'tshang rgya ba ltar snang yang sangs rgyas nyid rang ngo bo nyid kyang ma grub/ ngan song du 'gro ba ltar snang yang ngan song nyid ngo bo nyid kyang ma grub/ de thams cad ming tsam/ brda tsam/ btags pa tsam yin la/ bde sdug sogs ji ltar snang yang byang chub kyi sems thig le nyag gcig la ni bri gang bzang ngan gang yang med do// 'o na de lta bu'i dbang de slob dpon gang gis slob ma gang la bskur zhe na/ slob dpon sangs rgyas kyi cha la btags te rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs pa gcig gis so| |slob ma ni ye shes kyi cha la btags te snang ba thams cad byang chub kyi sems thig le nyag gcig gi dkyil 'khor du mthong ba zhig yin no// de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor de mthong bar 'dod cing mthong na gdong g.yogs don dam par bkrol bar yin no// rang rig don dam byang chub kyi sems thig le nyag gcig stong gsal chen po mthong ba ni don dam pa'i mig phye ba yin no| |rang rig chos kyi skur yid ches pa ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mthong ba yin no// de'i ngang las rang sems chos sku mi 'gyur ba ni/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa yin no// rang rig chos sku bsal bzhag med pa la brtan pa thob nas mngon du gyur pa ni don dam mchog gi dbang dang dngos grub thob pa yin no// de rnams ni rig pa rtsal gyi dbang zhes bya ba yin no// de lta bu'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum shin tu rab tu yongs su smin par byas/ shes bya'i sgrib pa cha shin tu phra ba bag la nyal dang bcas pa dag /phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje'i sku thob pa yin no// de ltar dbang rdzogs par thob nas/ de'i mtha' rten rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa la/ rang don dang*/ gzhan don gnyis las/ rang don mthar dbyung gi rjes gnang bya ba ni/ lha'i sku bstan la/ bu khyod kyis dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du lus tha mal du ma shor bar jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku sgom pa dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig /ces brjod/ shel phreng bstan la/ bu khyod kyis dus dang rnam pa thams cad du ngag tha mal du ma shor bar jo bo thugs rje chen po'i gsung yig ge drug ma bzla ba dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig |ces brjod/ me long bstan la/ bu khyod kyis dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du yid tha mal rnam rtog gi dbang du ma shor bar jo bo thugs rje chen po'i thugs spros bral zab gsal gnyis su med pa ye shes stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi ngang las mi 'bral bar gyis shig /ces brjod/ gzhan don phyogs med kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ gdan rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i steng du slob ma bzhag /mgo bor gdugs phub/ lag tu sgrub skor gyi po ti dang*/ spyi blugs/ rdor dril gtad/ dung 'bud du bcug la/ kye hoḥ khyab gdal chen po rin chen gdugs// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyob par gyis// chos kyi dung ni bla med mchog

/dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// 'khor los sgyur ba stobs po che// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// snying rje chen po blo yi mchog /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dbab par gyis| |dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes// nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos gyis// ji ltar 'khor ba ma stong bar// sems can don kun grub par gyis// rigs kyi bu khyod kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dam pa thob pas/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don phyogs dang ris su ma chad par gyis shig /ces brjod/ dngos grub kyi cho ga bya ba ni/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs| stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan par gyur/ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs las 'od zer 'phros pas steng lha/ 'og klu/ bar mi'i bdud rtsi/ 'jig rten gyi 'byung ba lnga/ rtsi shing*/ nags tshal/ sman bcud thams cad bsdus nas dngos grub kyi rdzas la thim pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad mchod cing sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba'i rdzas dam par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wa sh+yaṃ mā ra ya sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas/ rdzas rnams kyi phud bsdus te dkyil 'khor du 'bul zhing*/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pas yid 'phrog cing*// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog |ces brjod/ lhag ma rnams dpon slob thams cad la drangs shing*/ slob dpon gyis/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// gsol zhig sdig pa 'byang bar 'gyur// zhes brjod la longs spyad/ gzhan yang sngar bshad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang skabs 'dir bya'o// slob mas dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ yon dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bum mdun gyi lha la mchod bstod bya zhing*/

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gtang rag tu gtor ma bsngo/ phrin las bcol/ lhag chad kha bskangs shing shis brjod sogs mjug gi cho ga rnams sngar bshad pa'i sgrub chog khag gi dkyil chog gi skabs ltar bya'o// smras pa/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos 'gro la sman pa'i phyir// phyag na pad+mo'i smin grol rgyas dang bsdus// ji snyed bstsal ba grub thob dngos grub kyis// zab gter bzhes pa'i zab gsang rmad byung rnams// yongs su spel ba kho bo'i las su rigs// don med don log la sogs skyon drug spangs// don dang ldan sogs yon tan gsum rdzogs pa'i// legs bshad brtsams la 'phags pas legs so sbyin// deng sang sa steng zol zog mo bon gyis// gang ba'i khrod du rnam dag lam bzang 'di// 'chad dang ston dang nyams su len pa yang*// nyin skar tsam bas de phyir 'di dge yang*| |ma gyur 'gro la phyogs ris med par sbyin// de 'bras byang chub thob la bdag bsngo'o// de ltar chos skyong pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi sgrub khog chen mo dang*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i lag len pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang*| gtso bo rgyal po bka' 'bum nyid sor bzhag la mtshams sbyor dang dgos ched phran bu legs par spel te/ 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa shākya'i sras kyi dge slong chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rang lo drug cu re gcig la shing khams lug gi lo chu stod can gyi dkar po'i rdzogs pa dang por/ 'bri klung sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog rtse ba gzhis kar yongs su sbyar ba yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
